continuity_scope: Pearl Abyss Black Desert Asia (TH/SEA), English PC-service Edania pre-release story witness dated 14 August 2025: the official [Edania] The Five Demonlords GM Note, read with the region's 21 August 2025 first-Edania-update patch notes. The GM note profiles all five Demonlords as a staged Edania saga; the 21 August first update itself adds three questlines/bosses (Jordine, Rusalka, Enslar), while Cartian and Caphras are explicitly scheduled for the second update on 11 September. No release-state equivalence is assumed between this Asia service and NA/EU, Console, Korea, Global Lab, mobile, localization, or later revisions.

coverage_rule: All five individually named figures receiving a titled prose profile in the official Five Demonlords GM Note: Jordine Ducas, Enslar, Rusalka, Cartian, and Caphras of Adùir. These are stable named dramatic individuals expressly framed as the rulers/Demonlords of Edania. Named entities occurring only within a profile—Belmorn, Kzarka, Allan Serbin, Hadum, and the player-created Adventurer—are excluded because this witness does not separately profile them. Races, churches, orders, monsters, items, regions, knowledge, player titles, and systems are dimensions/terms, not nodes.
omissions: The player-created Adventurer, Family, class, appearance, gear, level, knowledge, quest selection/progress, PvP throne results, and all player-specific titles/rewards.

Belmorn, Kzarka, Allan Serbin, Hadum, Ynix, and all other named entities without their own source-profile under the stated rule; generic Demonlords, Valkyries, Merfolk, Luthraghon, Humans, Cyclops, Black Spirits, spirits, factions, monsters, items, castles, regions, knowledge, and mechanics as nodes.

The actual 21 August Edania play-state beyond its boundary facts, the 11 September second update, later balance/fix patches, NA/EU/Korea/Console/Global Lab/mobile material, all other regions/localizations/platforms, reworks/retcons, fan wikis, Wikipedia, walkthroughs, and community databases.
uncertainties: The Five Demonlords source is an official promotional GM Note published a week before the first Edania update, not an in-game transcript or full quest journal. It explicitly frames the five profiles as stories/legends and describes a staged release.

Rusalka's treasure and the availability of firsthand mermaid sightings are explicitly reported as rumor/uncertain in the official text; those claims remain marked needs-review rather than canonical fact.

Cartian's battle account is introduced as legend, and Caphras's Black Spirit research as 'is said to'; each is recorded with qualified confidence and not merged with the August 21 playable-boss roster.

The Aug 21 update permits a level-60 character to begin the pre-quest regardless of main-quest progress and limits weekly boss challenge selection, so player quest order and outcomes are not universalized.
The Asia English page itself reports a different Korean/global rollout schedule. It is not evidence for other regional wording, dates, platform content, patch states, or localization equivalence.
evidence_basis: Official Pearl Abyss Asia (TH/SEA) English GM Note with titled character profiles, plus the official regional first-update patch notes for date/staged-release/player-state boundaries. No fan resource is used as canonical evidence.
